sections.title: Habit and identification
sections.text: Crataegus laevigata, midland hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree of temperate Europe that can reach about 5–10 m. Its flowers are white or pinkish. It is close to Crataegus monogyna, but its flowers usually have two styles and its fruits two stones, compared with one in C. monogyna.

sections.title: Fruit and plate
sections.text: Its red fruits are traditionally eaten in juices, preserves or infusions. The plate shows the tree, leaves, flowers and cut fruits; styles and stones are useful comparative features, but can vary.
